title: Which dates gave these three answers?
description: Three final answers of the date trick, one thousand two hundred sixty nine, three hundred ninety four and two hundred ninety six, are turned back into dates. One hundred sixty five is taken away each time, and the last two digits give the day, as in the solved example.
teaching_notes: One idea: take away the fixed number, then read the day from the last two digits and the month from the digits before them. Watch for students who read the month from only the first digit of the reduced number.

source: Think of a Number tricks: find the dates
video_script.why: The child turns three final answers of the date trick back into dates by taking away one hundred sixty five, as the solved example did.
video_script.substitution: Take away 165 from each answer, read the day from the last two digits and the month from the digits before them.
video_script.anchor: three answer cards, 1269, 394 and 296, from the date trick
video_script.payoff_line: The dates are the fourth of November, the twenty ninth of February, and the thirty first of January.

final_answer.spoken: the fourth of November, the twenty ninth of February, and the thirty first of January

maths_rules: Each date is valid: a day is at most 31 and the month is 1 to 12.
video_script.design: One idea: take away 165, then split off the last two digits as the day. The three answer cards stay in the anchor band and each reading sits on the working board.

narration: <bookmark mark='take'/>Step one, take away one hundred sixty five from one thousand two hundred sixty nine. That leaves one thousand one hundred four.
<bookmark mark='read'/>The last two digits give the day, which is four. The digits before them give the month, which is eleven, so it is November.

marks.read: the last two digits 29 are boxed as the day and 2 as the month

narration: <bookmark mark='take'/>Step two, take away one hundred sixty five from three hundred ninety four. That leaves two hundred twenty nine.
<bookmark mark='read'/>The day is twenty nine, and the digit before it is two, so the month is February.

marks.read: the last two digits 31 are boxed as the day and 1 as the month

narration: <bookmark mark='take'/>Step three, take away one hundred sixty five from two hundred ninety six. That leaves one hundred thirty one.
<bookmark mark='read'/>The day is thirty one, and the digit before it is one, so the month is January.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>The dates are the fourth of November, the twenty ninth of February, and the thirty first of January.
